control.classHint: Class labels appear after selecting a model.
control.enableTracking: Enable ByteTrack (Webcam / RTSP / Wall; automatic for Video)
control.trackingHint: Enables trackId on bboxes, trails & counting lines/zones.
control.drawLineHint: Draw lines/zones via right-click menu or the buttons next to ROI tool.

image.dragHint: Drag image here, or click "Select Image".

video.analysisHint: Samples are processed sequentially at the selected FPS; speed depends on inference performance. Each run resets counts and starts at the beginning. Low sampling rates can still miss events. Changing the model, parameters or rules stops the run. Video events do not send live alerts.
video.lineHint: Click two points to create a line, then finish drawing.
video.zoneHint: Click polygon vertices, then click the first point to close (at least three vertices).
video.decodeError: Video decoding failed. Select the video again or check the file.
video.preparingUpload: This format needs a compatible preview. Uploading video…
video.preparingConvert: Creating an H.264 preview (video only). Long recordings may take several minutes:
video.prepareCancelled: Preview cancelled. Select the video again to retry.

wall.emptyHint: Enter RTSP address and click Start

monitor.countersHint: Enable Tracking and draw counting lines/zones on the canvas to see stats here.
monitor.alertRule: Rule: Alert triggers when target class appears for ≥ N consecutive frames.
monitor.noLogs: No logs yet (appears after model selection / inference).

webhook.hint: Backend sends JSON in selected format. Cooldown deduplicates by (kind, ref) to prevent spam.

config.dragHint: Drag JSON here. Includes: model params / engine / OSD / ROI / counting lines-zones / alerts / Webhook

vlm.title: POI video understanding
vlm.hint: Choose a video and draw lines or zones, then manage and enable event definitions below. Evidence is sampled per person and POI event for background analysis.
vlm.chooseVideo: Select a video and draw a POI first
vlm.noCandidates: No applicable POI triggers. Check geometry, anchor and trigger types.
vlm.confidence: Model self-reported confidence (uncalibrated; not event probability)
vlm.qualityNotes: Supporting information (does not change model judgment)
vlm.quality.inconsistent_conditions: Condition answers disagree with the model decision
vlm.quality.auxiliary_output_incomplete: Incomplete optional model fields; core decision preserved
vlm.quality.timeUnreliable: Frame time is not based on PTS
vlm.quality.evidenceTimeOutsideWindow: Out-of-window citations excluded from usable evidence
vlm.quality.different_segment_decisions: Segments differ; any matching segment preserves a match

vlmParameters.modelHint: Select local Qwen3-VL weights for the next task. 4B generally needs more GPU memory. Preview-only tasks do not load a model.
vlmParameters.modelUnavailableHint: Selected model was not found. Choose an available model or restore defaults.
vlmParameters.title: Analysis parameters
vlmParameters.savedHint: Valid settings are saved in this browser and applied to new tasks.
vlmParameters.advanced: Advanced: detection, tracking and POI stability
vlmParameters.invalid: Enter a valid value within the range; integer parameters require whole numbers.
vlmParameters.invalidFrames: Maximum frames must be an even number within the allowed range.
vlmParameters.fixBeforeStart: Correct the parameters before starting analysis.
vlmParameters.sampleFpsHint: Sample across the event window, also retaining trigger and boundary frames.
vlmParameters.maxFramesHint: Must be even. Higher limits increase inference time and GPU memory usage.
vlmParameters.maxPixelsHint: 196608 is standard; 393216 adds detail. Frames retain aspect ratio with model alignment.
vlmParameters.poseFpsHint: Controls tracking and POI detection, and the observation frames available to Qwen.
vlmParameters.maxNewTokensHint: A limit, not a target length. Generation stops on complete JSON; low limits can truncate answers.
vlmParameters.deviceHint: Default CUDA. Only affects pose detection; Qwen continues to use the GPU.
vlmParameters.confHint: Filters YOLO detections, not semantic event confidence.
vlmParameters.iouHint: Controls suppression of overlapping YOLO detection boxes.
vlmParameters.stableSecondsHint: Confirm a crossing, entry or exit after the state persists this long.
vlmParameters.hysteresisPxHint: Scaled from a 1920×1080 reference to reduce repeated triggers near boundaries.
vlmParameters.maxGapSecondsHint: Longer gaps begin a new track segment.
vlmParameters.rateHint: Qwen sampling exceeds pose detection rate; available frames are still limited by pose observations.
vlmParameters.samplingHint: Actual frames depend on the source, observation rate and frame cap. Odd counts repeat the last frame. Windows over 16 seconds are split.
vlmParameters.windowHint: Set pre/post context in each rule under Edit → Advanced conditions. Defaults: 4 seconds before, 6 seconds after.
vlmParameters.snapshot: View parameters used for this task

library.title: Records & videos
library.subtitle: Browse saved analyses and converted videos. Preview, rename and delete in one place.
library.search: Search name, original filename or record ID
library.selectPage: Select deletable records on this page
library.name: Name
library.activeProtected: Running analyses cannot be deleted. Stop the task in the console first.
library.retainHint: Completed videos are retained. This library covers saved semantic and offline rule analyses, excluding live session logs.
library.renameHint: Change the display name while preserving the original filename, record ID and video cache identity.
library.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Analysis results and evidence will be removed; shared source videos are retained. Saved conversions will be deleted and must be converted again if the original is reuploaded.
library.playbackError: The browser cannot play this source video. Download it to view.
library.noResults: No results available. Check the task status and record information.

eventRules.title: Event definitions
eventRules.hint: Checkboxes select batch actions; switches control analysis participation. Changes remain drafts until saved. POI bindings apply to the current analysis only.
eventRules.empty: No rules. Add or import definitions.
eventRules.limit: Enable at most 30 rules per analysis.
eventRules.name: Rule name
eventRules.description: Event description (question sent to the model)
eventRules.bulkHint: Enter one description per line or paste existing JSON. Preview, add to the list, then save.
eventRules.importUpdate: Update matching IDs; add the rest
eventRules.deleteWarning: Delete these rules? Saved rules are removed immediately. Historical and running analyses are unaffected.
eventRules.notReady: Enable 1–30 valid rules and configure compatible POIs.
eventRules.snapshot: Event definitions used for this analysis
